caseName: Interstate Commerce Commission v. Overland Express, Inc.
caseNameFull: Interstate Commerce Commission v. Overland Express, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for farther consideration in light of Security Services, Inc. v. Kmart Corp., ante, p. 431. Justice Ginsburg took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
